cases.title: Local service appointment booking
cases.idea: An application where customers book appointments with local service providers and providers manage availability.

cases.title: Small marketplace with refunds
cases.idea: A marketplace where independent sellers list products, customers place orders, and administrators handle refunds.

cases.title: Real-time whiteboard rooms
cases.idea: A collaborative whiteboard with private rooms, live drawing, reconnect support, history, and export.

cases.title: Multi-warehouse inventory alerts
cases.idea: An inventory application that tracks stock across warehouses and alerts operators before products run out.

cases.title: Event ticket reservations
cases.idea: A ticketing application where users reserve seats, pay, receive tickets, and request cancellations.

cases.title: Team expense approvals
cases.idea: An application for employees to submit expenses and for managers and finance staff to review and approve them.

cases.title: Offline field inspections
cases.idea: A mobile application where field inspectors complete checklists and capture photos while offline, then synchronize later.

cases.title: Multi-tenant subscription workspace
cases.idea: A subscription SaaS where organizations create workspaces, invite members, assign roles, and manage billing.

cases.title: Community content moderation
cases.idea: A community application where members publish posts, report abuse, and moderators review reports and appeals.

cases.title: Challenging distributed project workspace
cases.idea: A global project workspace with organization-scoped documents, real-time co-editing, offline edits, regional data residency, external guests, and immutable audit history.
